The game has been downloaded 20 million times.
Age of Magic
This was announced by the developer and publisher of the project — the company Playkot. The company also noted that today Age of Magic is one of its key projects.
Recall, in July, the company reported that its city-building simulator SuperCity had earned about $100 million on mobile and web platforms over 15 years.
Age of Magic is a mobile battler in the spirit of RAID: Shadow Legends. The player assembles a roster of heroes, upgrades them, and uses them to battle squads of virtual opponents and other players.
Today, the project continues to develop actively. Each month, 4-5 updates are released for it, and the number of events is counted in dozens.
